import sys;sys.setrecursionlimit(100000000)
H,W,N=map(int,sys.stdin.readline().split())
grid=[["."]*W for i in range(H)]
directions=((-1,0),(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1))
dirNum=0
x=0
y=0
for i in range(N):
    if grid[y][x]==".":
        grid[y][x]="#"
        dirNum = (dirNum + 1) % 4
    else:
        grid[y][x]="."
        dirNum = (dirNum - 1) % 4
    y = (y + directions[dirNum][0]) % H
    x = (x + directions[dirNum][1]) % W
    if y < 0:
        y += H
    if x < 0:
        x += W
for clm in grid:
    print(''.join(clm))
</patched>
